_readme: Default: every subagent spawn is blocked until the model has shown you the whole
plan in the terminal (via AskUserQuestion) and you have chosen a model for each.
You see all of them before any of them runs.
Rules run before approval and are for spawns you never want to be asked about.
Anything a rule handles is applied silently and does NOT appear in the plan, so
keep this list empty if you want to see everything. Two useful ones are in
_optionalRules below: move them into 'rules' to stop being asked about trivia.
Actions: allow | force-model | prompt (plan approval) | ask (built-in yes/no) | deny
Regex note: JSON needs doubled backslashes. Write \\b for a word boundary. A
single backslash followed by b is the backspace character, and a rule containing
it silently matches nothing. Run 'node install.mjs --check' to catch that.
planMaxAgeMs is how long an approved plan stays valid, in milliseconds.

_optionalRules.name: trivial-tasks
_optionalRules.note: Observed trivial spawns ran 68-163 chars; real research started around 490.

_optionalRules.name: search-shaped-agents
_optionalRules.note: Explore exists to grep and locate. It rarely needs a frontier model.
